  (start:PlantItem {tag: 'P-1-1'})-[:line_to*]->(finish:PlantItem {tag: 'P-10-2'})
)
UNWIND nodes(p) AS item
MATCH (item)-[:DESCRIBED_BY]->(dev)
MATCH (d)
WHERE d.document_id = dev.document_id
  AND (d:plm__PCA_100029511 OR d:plm__PCA_100029508 OR d:plm__PCA_100029510)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029520]->(caseNode)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029525]->(section)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:lis__datumUOM]->(uom)
WITH item, d, caseNode, section, uom
WHERE any(term IN ['maximum allowable pressure', 'max allowable pressure', 'allowable pressure'] WHERE
  toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS term OR
  toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029522, '')) CONTAINS term OR
  toLower(coalesce(caseNode.rdfs__label, '')) CONTAINS term OR
  toLower(coalesce(section.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS term OR
  toLower(coalesce(section.dct__description, '')) CONTAINS term
)
RETURN DISTINCT
  item.tag AS tag,
  d.plm__PCA_100029521 AS label,
  d.plm__PCA_100029522 AS value,
  d.lis__datumValue AS numeric_value,
  uom.uri AS unit,
  caseNode.rdfs__label AS case,
  section.plm__PCA_100029521 AS source_title,
  section.dct__type AS source_type,
  section.dct__description AS source_description,
  d.schema__pageStart AS page
ORDER BY numeric_value ASC, tag
LIMIT 200

MATCH (a:PlantItem {tag: 'CHV-1-1'}), (b:PlantItem {tag: 'P-14-6'})
MATCH p = shortestPath((a)-[:line_to*]->(b))
UNWIND nodes(p) AS item
MATCH (item)-[:DESCRIBED_BY]->(dev)
CALL {
  WITH dev
  MATCH (d)
  WHERE d.document_id = dev.document_id
    AND (d:plm__PCA_100029511 OR d:plm__PCA_100029508 OR d:plm__PCA_100029510)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029520]->(c)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029525]->(s)
  WHERE toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable pressure'
     OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029522, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable pressure'
     OR toLower(coalesce(c.rdfs__label, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable pressure'
     OR toLower(coalesce(s.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable pressure'
     OR toLower(coalesce(s.dct__description, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable pressure'
     OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'allowable pressure'
     OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029522, '')) CONTAINS 'allowable pressure'
     OR toLower(coalesce(c.rdfs__label, '')) CONTAINS 'allowable pressure'
     OR toLower(coalesce(s.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'allowable pressure'
     OR toLower(coalesce(s.dct__description, '')) CONTAINS 'allowable pressure'
  OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029514]->(f)
  RETURN d, c, s, f
  UNION
  WITH dev
  MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029525]->(s)
  WHERE d.document_id = dev.document_id
    AND (d:plm__PCA_100029511 OR d:plm__PCA_100029508 OR d:plm__PCA_100029510)
    AND (
      toLower(coalesce(s.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable pressure'
      OR toLower(coalesce(s.dct__description, '')) CONTAINS 'maximum allowable pressure'
      OR toLower(coalesce(s.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'allowable pressure'
      OR toLower(coalesce(s.dct__description, '')) CONTAINS 'allowable pressure'
    )
  OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029520]->(c)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029514]->(f)
  RETURN d, c, s, f
}
RETURN item.tag AS tag,
       d.plm__PCA_100029521 AS label,
       d.plm__PCA_100029522 AS value,
       c.rdfs__label AS case,
       f.plm__PCA_100029522 AS footnote,
       s.plm__PCA_100029521 AS source_title,
       s.dct__type AS source_type,
       s.dct__description AS source_description,
       d.schema__pageStart AS page
LIMIT 200
